renderscale.name: RenderScale
text.autoconfig.renderscale.title: RenderScale Options
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.scale: Relative to your current window size.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr.@: Results may vary depending on your hardware. Compare your FPS!
Results may vary depending on your hardware, compare your FPS!
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsrcn: CNN upscaler (igv's FSRCNNX x2 8-0-4-1). Fixed 2x network: active at 50% scale and below, falls back otherwise. Slower than FSR1, sharper on lines/text. Needs 26.2+.
CNN 2x upscaler, best at 50% scale. Slower than FSR, sharper detail.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.minie: CNN upscaler (MiniESPCN x2 student: conv 3-8 + depthwise + mix + residual shuffle over a Keys bicubic base). Fixed 2x network: active at 50% scale and below, falls back otherwise. Wins over FSRCNNX when both are on. Needs 26.2+.
CNN 2x upscaler with bicubic base, best at 50% scale. Wins over FSRCNNX.

Heavy CNN upscaler (MiniESPCN-Q: 32ch + 5x5 conv + shuffle, ~15k MAC/px, no bicubic base). Fixed 2x network: active at 50% scale and below, falls back otherwise. Needs a discrete GPU. Wins over MiniESPCN/FSRCNNX when several are on. Needs 26.2+.
Heavy CNN 2x upscaler, best at 50% scale. Needs a discrete GPU. Wins over MiniESPCN.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.tempo: Use Temporal Upscale (Experimental)
Camera-jitter TAAU inspired by shaderpacks. Needs no motion vectors, dynamic objects may ghost slightly.
Camera-jitter TAAU. Cheaper than FSR at low scales, dynamic objects may ghost.
Temporal upscaler: YCoCg accumulation with 3x3 AABB clamp, thin-feature lock, reactive mask for emissive pixels, disocclusion via depth, RCAS sharpen at the end. Wins over TAAU when both are on.
YCoCg temporal + RCAS. Best quality, costs more than TAAU.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr2S: Final RCAS sharpness for FSR 2 (0-100, higher = sharper).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr2R: How fast history is dropped on emissive/flickering pixels like lava, fire and torches (0 = off, 100 = aggressive).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsr2N: Diagnostic: skip history accumulation, show the Lanczos reconstruction only. If this is sharp and still, jitter is fine and ghosting comes from reprojection.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.tempo: Force temporal under shaders
Run our TAAU even with an Iris pack active. Turn the pack's own TAA off first, or they fight. Smears shader speculars (no depth data).
Run our TAAU under Iris (pack TAA off). May smear water/speculars.
Temporal EASU base
Edge-adaptive upscale before temporal resolve. Sharper, but the most expensive pass. Off = bilinear base (faster).
Sharper base image, costs FPS. Off = faster bilinear.
Depth reprojection
Per-pixel camera motion from depth (FSR2-style). Kills smear on turns. Off = jitter-only fallback.
Kills motion smear via depth. Off = fallback.
Sample real depth

Use the depth texture for per-pixel motion + disocclusion (drops stale history on uncovered background) + foreground depth dilation. Off = far-plane assumption (exact for rotation). Turn on only if the depth debug view shows a real gradient.
Enables disocclusion + edge dilation. Off unless depth debug shows gradient.
Off unless depth debug shows gradient.
TAAU debug view
0 = off, 1 = depth grayscale, 2 = motion vectors as color. For diagnosing reprojection.
0 = off, 1 = depth, 2 = motion.
Off
Depth
Motion
Temporal sharpness
RCAS-like sharpening after temporal resolve (0-100).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.fsrSh: RCAS sharpness for FSR1 (0-100, higher = sharper).
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.dynam: Auto-adjust render scale to hold the target FPS. Works with any upscaler.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.targe: Dynamic resolution aims for this framerate.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.dynMi: Lowest scale dynamic resolution will drop to.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.dynMa: Highest scale dynamic resolution will climb to.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.hudEn: In-game overlay: render scale, FPS and active upscaler.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.force: Forces bilinear upscaling on scale factors less than 100%.
text.autoconfig.renderscale.option.irisS: The scale factor when shaders are enabled.
